name: Son La Dam
kicker: Dam and reservoir on the Da
summary: Look at the dam from the public side, then leave. One visit is an outside look of about 30–45 minutes, described as free, with the plant below closed. Another is a registered visit of about 2–3 hours, free or very low. The drive is about 40 km or about 60 km. Check the gate.
getThere: Highway 279 north. About 40 km, or about 60 km.
heroCaption: The dam wall at It Ong, the Da below it, and the ridges behind

notice.title: The visit rules disagree
notice.body: The outside look is free and the plant below the dam is closed. A registered visit of about 2–3 hours is free or very low. Check which door is open.

body: Stand on the public side and look at the wall. The plant is at Ít Ong, Mường La, on the Đà, not in the town center. EVN inaugurated it on 23 December 2012. Installed capacity is 2,400 MW, six units of 400 MW. The reservoir is 9.26 billion m³. Normal level 215 m, surcharge 217.83 m, dead water 175 m. The gravity dam is 138.1 m high, with a crest of 961.6 m and a crest elevation of 228.1 m. The base is 105 m wide and the crest is 10 m wide.

A lake surface of 224 km² at design level is also given. The inauguration figures do not include that surface, so 224 km² stays as its own figure. The dam is about 40 km and about one hour north of the city, and also about 60 km from the city center. The one-hour figure belongs to the 40 km account. Minutes for the 60 km figure are check on arrival.

An outside look is about 30–45 minutes, with the plant below the dam closed. A registered visit is about 2–3 hours, free or very low. Do not plan a tour inside the powerhouse when the outside look is the visit. Boat tours are given as 7:00–17:00. Time on the water, and a boat fee, are check on arrival. October–April are the dry months for this reservoir, and early morning or late afternoon is the hour for the viewpoint. The dam is the trip north of town. It is not the picture of the night under Khau Ca.

gettingThere: Leave the valley on Highway 6, then take Highway 279 north to Mường La. The dam is about 40 km and about one hour north of the city, and also about 60 km from the city center. Keep both distances. Minutes for the 60 km figure are check on arrival. A taxi fare on the shorter account is not the price for the longer one. The fare is check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Son La
legs.body: Highway 279 north to Mường La. About 40 km and about one hour, or about 60 km. Minutes for 60 km are check on arrival.

hours: Check on arrival. One boat window is 7:00–17:00. An outside look is about 30–45 minutes, and a plant visit is about 2–3 hours.
closed: The plant below the dam is closed on the outside look. A registered visit does not repeat that. Check the gate on arrival.
admissionNote: The outside view is described as free, and also as free or very low if you register ahead. A current gate tariff is check on arrival. A boat fee is check on arrival.
